key_reasoning.reason: Touches ability (authz), user repository, assistant model/repository, permission and assistant routers, activity models/repository, AssistantShareService and permission creation/deletion services: 3-4 components across API, service and persistence, with the shared ability/permission utilities involved.

Authorization-sensitive sharing (owner checks, external-user and personal-integration rejection, grant/revoke with audit). Closest pattern is the existing DATASOURCE permission flow, which does not cover per-user ASSISTANT grants or concurrent grant races (handled with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING), so scored as a divergence. Defensive edge cases (external/inactive/deleted users, duplicates, unknown users) are enumerated and covered by new error-path tests.

About 25 files from this run (diffstat counts 47 for the whole branch including earlier feature work and planning artifacts): about 14 source files plus one alembic migration and about 14 test files across src/codemie, src/external and tests directories. Mostly small review-fix edits, but the count maps to the XXL band.

API (assistant and permission routers), Service (share, permission creation/deletion), DB-persistence (alembic migration syncing the resourcetype enum with ASSISTANT, with a downgrade that deletes ASSISTANT rows). No UI or external layer.
